The top keeper from sniper_real_fills_grinder (vol_mult=1.1, body_min_cents=0.02, min_stars=2, strike_offset=2, premium_stop_pct=-0.1, tp1_premium_pct=0.5, tp1_qty_fraction=0.5, runner_target_pct=2.0, profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.05, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05, qty=10, proximity_dollars=1.5, require_break_above_open=true) shows negative edge_capture (-126.0) and wide_pnl (-90.8) with a 50% win rate. ## Mechanism

**Entry:** SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK with volatility multiplier 1.1 (slightly expanded volume requirement), minimum 2-star confirmation, body minimum 2 cents to filter dojis, strike offset 2 (OTM-2 puts), proximity trigger within $1.50 of level. Requires break above open to avoid false breakdowns.  
**Exit:** Premium stop at -10% (catastrophe cap), TP1 at +50% selling half, runner target at 200% (2R), profit-lock arms at +5% and trails stop by 5% of HWM.  
**Note:** This is a real-fills grinder output, so exit logic uses realistic OPRA simulation.
